safe_stop_stale_characterization: All 4 SAFE_STOP_STALE occurrences are confined to the pre-encounter STARTUP_HOLD window: 2 per robot, each a WAITING->SAFE_STOP_STALE->STARTUP_HOLD transition pair completing within ~250ms, at ros_time approximately 23-26s. This is clearly separated in time from the controller's own first AVOID_TURN transition at ros_time=36.660s (roughly 11-14s later) -- confirmed by direct inspection of controller.log context lines, not inferred. Note: the bag-based geometric CPA recomputation (analyze_trigger_reason.py) finds its trigger_time_s at ros_time=21.609s, i.e. BEFORE the SAFE_STOP_STALE transitions -- this is not a contradiction: that figure marks when the raw position/velocity data first satisfies the CPA/proximity geometry test across the whole bag, independent of whether the controller's own state machine had already reached an operational (non-STARTUP_HOLD) mode at that instant. The controller's own committed encounter response (AVOID_TURN) does not begin until ros_time=36.660s, well after both the geometric trigger point and the SAFE_STOP_STALE/STARTUP_HOLD transitions.
